krypton_modes.npz.model: 309 numerical sites; eight displacement modes; this is a distinct preparation from the neutral atlas count.

carbon_geometry.npz.model: 34-site candidate relaxation, including 21 surface sites. The neutral count has conditional reconstruction status in the R557 atlas.

krypton_pair.dat.model: Numerical Kr pair potential from the research package; first eight entries specify the analytic curve.

krypton_units.json.model: Native-to-SI scale including the common size correction.

light-element-relaxations.npz.source: Atomic relaxed stable bases H–Kr, V65. All 36 full candidate geometries including native surface markers.

substrate-grid.json.source: Nine coefficient-grid runs from physics_support/croisement_substrate.json in the benchmark inputs. The two numerical controls are excluded from the coefficient selector.
